review_scope_note: Unlike prior API-based reviews that saw only the finding text, this audit had full repository access: experiment kernels, archived run logs/CSVs, prior reviews, remediations, and paper/CERTIFICATE.md where applicable. Quantitative claims were checked against primary artifacts; arithmetic and hashes were recomputed where feasible. No computational result was invented.
verification_methods: Validated analysis_n40.json against finding frontmatter for partitions, entries, nonzero counts, max|χ|, time
Verified dim_sum_check against 40! and hooks/near-rect/sample blocks
Recomputed binom(37340,3) unique triples; verified near-rect SHA protocol mention
Noted int64 overflow on full GPU triple-sum attempt in HF log narrative

overall_assessment: The strongest locally auditable Kronecker result: character-table stats, dimension check, hooks, near-rectangulares, and the 1000-triple sample all cohere in analysis_n40.json. This is real representation-theory computation at a scale worth citing, provided sampled nonzero rates are never mistaken for exact censuses and the S30 cross-talk is cleaned up.
recommendations: Do not let the S30 max-g contradiction contaminate this page's cross-table
When int128 full triple-sum exists, publish it as a new finding rather than silently upgrading this one
certification_justification: Methods are classical (character theory / Kronecker coefficients); local artifacts validate the core table and targeted analyses. Gold would require independent external replication of the full table.
